AdjudicationRequest.description:
An expert decision on one resolution work item.

``objects`` is required to edit or replace and ignored when accepting.
``source_submission_id`` names the raw submission an
``edit_submission`` started from. A rationale is required for edits,
replacements, conflicted self-adjudication, and overriding an earlier
expert decision.
AdjudicationRequest.title: AdjudicationRequest

AdjudicationResponse.description: The recorded decision and the image's new resolution, if it closed.
AdjudicationResponse.title: AdjudicationResponse

AdministratorPasswordReset.description: Administrator request to replace another user's password.
AdministratorPasswordReset.title: AdministratorPasswordReset

AnnotationImportCreate.description: Create-import request naming the source format and its files.
AnnotationImportCreate.title: AnnotationImportCreate

AnnotationImportResponse.description: Label import representation with its provenance and review report.
AnnotationImportResponse.title: AnnotationImportResponse

AnnotationObject.description: One labelled object; classification labels carry no geometry.
AnnotationObject.title: AnnotationObject

AnnotationPolicyResponse.description: Policy representation expected by the App.
AnnotationPolicyResponse.title: AnnotationPolicyResponse

AnnotationPolicyUpdate.description:
Optimistically versioned policy replacement.

``version`` carries the version the caller believes is current.
``parameters`` and ``review_thresholds`` are validated against the task's
closed pipeline configuration, which ``GET /capabilities`` describes;
omitted values take their defaults.
AnnotationPolicyUpdate.title: AnnotationPolicyUpdate

AssignmentDetail.description:
One assignment opened by its annotator.

``objects`` is the caller's draft while the work is open and their latest
submission once it is submitted. ``seeded_from_import`` says the work began
from imported labels without exposing the import itself. ``resolution``
is present only once the image is resolved.
AssignmentDetail.title: AssignmentDetail

AssignmentMedia.description: The image being annotated, with a short-lived signed URL for its bytes.
AssignmentMedia.title: AssignmentMedia

AssignmentQueueCounts.description: The caller's own workload in the project.
AssignmentQueueCounts.title: AssignmentQueueCounts

AssignmentQueueItem.description: One of the caller's own assignments, without any peer information.
AssignmentQueueItem.title: AssignmentQueueItem

AssignmentQueuePage.description: Cursor-paginated personal queue with the caller's counts.
AssignmentQueuePage.title: AssignmentQueuePage

BatchAssignment.description: One assignment as a manager sees it, without its document content.
BatchAssignment.title: BatchAssignment

BatchPolicyUpdate.description:
Replacement policy for a batch that has not started.

There is no ``version`` here: a batch's policy is a snapshot rather than a
shared resource, and the batch status is what decides whether it may still
change.
BatchPolicyUpdate.title: BatchPolicyUpdate

BatchResponse.description:
Batch representation carrying its policy snapshot and progress.

Image counts and assignment counts are reported separately because one
image carries one assignment per configured annotator, so the two never
coincide in consensus mode. Submitted assignments never imply resolved
images: an image is resolved only by its canonical resolution. Cancelled
images and reassigned or cancelled assignments are outside the totals.
BatchResponse.title: BatchResponse

CanonicalAnnotationObject.description: One object of a canonical document written by an expert.
CanonicalAnnotationObject.title: CanonicalAnnotationObject

CanonicalPolygonGeometry.description:
A polygon of a canonical document, which may trace a mask outline with
up to 10,000 points per ring (D14).
CanonicalPolygonGeometry.title: CanonicalPolygonGeometry

CapabilitiesResponse.description: Limits and features that clients must discover at runtime.
CapabilitiesResponse.title: CapabilitiesResponse

DatasetLayoutResponse.description:
A project's prepared layout, its initial batches, and its training pool.

Before preparation every count is zero and ``prepared_at`` is null. A
``single_batch`` project has no split rows, no first training batch, and
no training pool.
DatasetLayoutResponse.title: DatasetLayoutResponse

DependencyStatus.description: Readiness state for one external dependency.
DependencyStatus.title: DependencyStatus

DocumentWrite.description:
A draft save or a final submission of the complete image document.

``version`` is the assignment version the caller last read; a different
current version means someone else changed the work first.
DocumentWrite.title: DocumentWrite

ErrorBody.description: Stable machine- and human-readable error details.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

ErrorEnvelope.description: Envelope used for all API application errors.
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

EvidenceResponse.description: Everything an owner or manager needs to review one image.
EvidenceResponse.title: EvidenceResponse

EvidenceVersions.description: The values a manager action must send back as its expected versions.
EvidenceVersions.title: EvidenceVersions

FinalResolution.description:
An image's accepted canonical annotation as its annotators may see it.

``source`` says whether it came from the single submission, automatic
consensus, or an expert's adjudication; nothing about peers is included.
FinalResolution.title: FinalResolution

ImportErrorResponse.description: One reason the import cannot be accepted.
ImportErrorResponse.title: ImportErrorResponse

ImportFileResponse.description: One source file and whether its bytes have arrived.
ImportFileResponse.title: ImportFileResponse

ImportManifestFile.description:
One label file the client intends to upload.

``size_bytes`` may be zero: an empty YOLO file marks an image as empty.
ImportManifestFile.title: ImportManifestFile

ImportReport.description:
Preview of what accepting the import would seed.

Images without labels stay valid, unlabelled images; they are counted
rather than reported as errors.
ImportReport.title: ImportReport

LeaseResponse.description: An active edit lease on one work item.
LeaseResponse.title: LeaseResponse

MediaResponse.description: One ingested image, with the original dimensions annotation depends on.
MediaResponse.title: MediaResponse

ParameterDescriptor.description:
One settable resolver field, described so a client can render and
validate it without hard-coding its meaning.

``name`` is dotted for fields inside a nested group. Ratio bounds and
defaults are ``{"numerator", "denominator"}`` objects; an ``area`` value
is ``{"pixels", "image_ratio"}``.
ParameterDescriptor.title: ParameterDescriptor

PasswordChange.description: Authenticated user's request to replace their own password.
PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange

PerformanceReport.description: Project-scoped annotator performance for owners and managers.
PerformanceReport.title: PerformanceReport

PerformanceSummary.description:
Aggregate agreement of one annotator for one evaluation source.

``outcomes``, ``metrics`` and ``classes`` are null when the row has fewer
than ``minimum_decisions`` decisions; an individual value is null when
fewer than ``minimum_cell`` observations back it.
PerformanceSummary.title: PerformanceSummary

PipelineCapability.description:
The resolver pipeline of one task type, sent as the policy
``resolver``.
PipelineCapability.title: PipelineCapability

PolicyChange.description: One audited change of the default policy and the fields it changed.
PolicyChange.title: PolicyChange

PolicyHistory.description:
The read-only history of a project's default policy (A6-04).

``preparing_batches`` counts the batches a change can still reach; started
batches keep their own snapshot.
PolicyHistory.title: PolicyHistory

PolygonGeometry.description: Rings of flat ``[x1, y1, x2, y2, ...]`` points in original-image pixels.
PolygonGeometry.title: PolygonGeometry

ProjectClassResponse.description: Object class representation expected by the App.
ProjectClassResponse.title: ProjectClassResponse

ProjectCreate.description:
Create-project request contract.

A ``split`` project requires ``iteration_batch_size`` and one count or
percentage for each held-out split. ``initial_training_size`` is optional:
when omitted, the first training batch uses ``iteration_batch_size``.

A ``single_batch`` project annotates every image once and never trains, so
it accepts no size at all and only the ``random`` acquisition strategy.
ProjectCreate.title: ProjectCreate

ProjectMemberCreate.description: Add-member request naming an existing user.
ProjectMemberCreate.title: ProjectMemberCreate

ProjectMemberResponse.description: Membership representation expected by the App.
ProjectMemberResponse.title: ProjectMemberResponse

ProjectMemberUpdate.description: Role change for an existing member.
ProjectMemberUpdate.title: ProjectMemberUpdate

ProjectResponse.description: Project representation expected by the App.
ProjectResponse.title: ProjectResponse

ProjectUpdate.description:
Optimistically versioned editable project fields.

``acquisition_strategy`` may change on a ``split`` project, before or
after activation. It decides how later training acquisition batches are
chosen; it never alters the fixed splits or the initial batches.
ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate

ReadinessResponse.description: Aggregate dependency and migration readiness state.
ReadinessResponse.title: ReadinessResponse

RectangleGeometry.description: A box as ``[x, y, width, height]`` in original-image pixels.
RectangleGeometry.title: RectangleGeometry

ResolutionQueueItem.description: One open case in a batch's manager queue, without full evidence.
ResolutionQueueItem.title: ResolutionQueueItem

ResolutionQueuePage.description: A cursor page of the manager queue.
ResolutionQueuePage.title: ResolutionQueuePage

ResolutionView.description: One canonical resolution version of the image.
ResolutionView.title: ResolutionView

ResolverConfigurationWrite.description: An explicit configuration for a manual retry, validated like a policy.
ResolverConfigurationWrite.title: ResolverConfigurationWrite

ResolverEligibility.description: The project's current eligibility for the conditional strategies.
ResolverEligibility.title: ResolverEligibility

RetryRequest.description: Ask for a new resolver run over the image's latest evidence.
RetryRequest.title: RetryRequest

ReviewEvidenceWrite.description:
A private review draft or submission.

A draft may be incomplete. A submission must be an
:class:`ImageReviewEvidence` for an image case or a
:class:`CandidateReviewEvidence` for a candidate case (D16).
ReviewEvidenceWrite.title: ReviewEvidenceWrite

RunView.description: A resolver run with its provenance and outcome.
RunView.title: RunView

SamPrompt.description: Prompt sent to the assisted segmentation endpoint.
SamPrompt.title: SamPrompt

StrategyCapability.description:
A selectable class or geometry strategy of a pipeline.

A ``conditional`` strategy also depends on project evidence, reported by
``GET /projects/{project_id}/resolver-eligibility``. A non-null
``unavailable_reason`` means it cannot be selected; nothing is ever
substituted for it.
StrategyCapability.title: StrategyCapability

StrategyEligibility.description: Whether one conditional strategy has the evidence it needs (D11).
StrategyEligibility.title: StrategyEligibility

SubmissionEvidence.description: One immutable annotator submission, named for owners and managers.
SubmissionEvidence.title: SubmissionEvidence

SubmissionReceived.description:
Result of a final submission.

``image_resolved`` is true only in single mode, where the submission itself
becomes the canonical resolution. In consensus mode it is always false so
the answer never reveals whether peers have submitted.
SubmissionReceived.title: SubmissionReceived

UploadChunkResponse.description: Acknowledgement of one accepted chunk, naming the next expected offset.
UploadChunkResponse.title: UploadChunkResponse

UploadItemResponse.description: Per-file disposition and progress within a session.
UploadItemResponse.title: UploadItemResponse

UploadManifestFile.description: One file the client intends to upload, described before any bytes move.
UploadManifestFile.title: UploadManifestFile

UploadSessionCreate.description: Create-session request carrying the client's local manifest.
UploadSessionCreate.title: UploadSessionCreate

UploadSessionResponse.description: Upload session representation expected by the App.
UploadSessionResponse.title: UploadSessionResponse

UserCreate.description: Administrator request to create a user.
UserCreate.title: UserCreate

UserUpdate.description:
Optimistically versioned editable user fields.

``username`` is absent on purpose: it is immutable after creation, so
immutability is a property of the contract rather than a runtime check.
UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate

WorkItemView.description: One image-level or candidate-level case with its lease and decisions.
WorkItemView.title: WorkItemView

get.description:
Stream one image's bytes to the holder of a signed link.

The signature is the authorization: it is issued only inside an
assignment the caller owns and expires shortly after, so no bearer token
is needed and none is ever placed in a URL.

Args:

    expires: Expiry time from the signed link, as a Unix timestamp.
    signature: Signature from the signed link.
    session: Active database session.

Returns:
    The image bytes with their media type.

    _: Authenticated administrator.
